title: Region selection system: box/ellipse/magic-wand, PS modifiers, region-targeted fill, ⌘N new layer
goal: USER (2026-07-04, verbatim intent): Photoshop-style REGION selection — box select, circle select, magic wand, snap to edges, ⇧/⌥ modifiers to add/remove — and region-targeted operations: fill the selected area; ⌘N creates a new (empty) layer WITHOUT resetting the selection so you can fill on it. Region selection is distinct from layer selection (the arrow tool) and SUPERSEDES layers by default: while a region exists, ops (fill, delete, copy) target the region. This replaces/extends today's rect-only marquee (EditorState.selection: CGRect).

designNotes.model: Selection becomes a PATH-based region, not a CGRect. Core type SelectionRegion wrapping CGPath (CoreGraphics-only, OK for PhotonzCore; it is EDITOR state, not document state — no Codable needed, lives on EditorState like the current rect). Booleans via the macOS 13+ CGPath.union/subtracting/intersection(using:) APIs — VERIFY these behave on macOS 26 before building on them (spike first). Rect/ellipse builders; bounds accessor (existing consumers need a rect); contains(point). Magic wand output (a bitmap mask from flood fill) converts to CGPath via a marching-squares contour tracer (core, TDD) so EVERYTHING stays path-based and ants/fill/booleans are uniform.
designNotes.wand: Flood fill from the click point over the COMPOSITE bitmap (what the user sees), tolerance option (Euclidean RGB distance), contiguous-only v1. Runs off-main like the edge map (Task.detached; cache not needed — one-shot per click). Render-side helper in PhotonzRender (needs bitmaps), TDD with synthetic fixtures.
designNotes.toolsAndModifiers: New tools: rect-select, ellipse-select, magic wand. The CURRENT select tool (arrow) stays layer selection. Today's plain-drag marquee on the arrow tool should keep working (it IS rect-select in practice — decide whether arrow-drag delegates to the new region system; recommended: yes, one selection model everywhere). Modifiers at gesture start: ⇧ add, ⌥ subtract, ⇧⌥ intersect. SHORTCUT CONFLICTS to resolve with the user: PS uses M/W but M=measure here; candidates: S (rect select), ⇧S cycle to ellipse, W (wand) — W is free.
designNotes.snapping: Marquee corners magnetize to the EdgeMap exactly like measure corners (EdgeSnapping, windowed queries, ⌘ bypass). The edge map is currently GATED to the measure tool (EditorState.measureEdgeMap) — widen the gate to selection tools.
designNotes.regionSupersedesLayer: While a region exists: bucket/⌥⌫ fill paints the region (clipped path) INTO the target layer's pixels — for image layers bake into a copy of the bitmap (destructive-but-undoable, like merge); ⌫ erases region pixels to transparent on the selected image layer; ⌘C copies the region from the composite (exists for rects — generalize to path with clip). Existing consumers of selection:CGRect to migrate: promoteSelectionToLayer/⌘J, blurBehindSelection, copy, Document.layerIDs(fullyInside:) (use region bounds), CanvasView ants (CAShapeLayer takes any CGPath — swap paths; marching-ants crawl animation unchanged).
designNotes.cmdN: NEW EMPTY LAYER command (canvas-sized transparent image layer), selection PRESERVED (it is EditorState state — simply do not clear it on layer add; audit setSelection(nil) call sites). SHORTCUT = OPEN DECISION, ask the user before wiring (discussed 2026-07-04, no answer yet): Photoshop uses ⌘N for New DOCUMENT, ⇧⌘N for New Layer (with dialog), ⌥⇧⌘N instant. Option A (user's original ask): ⌘N = new layer; move New from Clipboard to ⌥⌘N. Option B (PS parity): keep ⌘N = New from Clipboard, ⇧⌘N = instant new layer; move New Window (current ⇧⌘N) to ⌥⌘N.
designNotes.fillOnNewLayer: The user's flow: make a selection → ⌘N → bucket/⌥⌫ → the fill lands on the fresh transparent layer clipped to the region, selection still active for further ops. Empty image layer = registered transparent bitmap (or a lighter 'empty' content? simplest: canvas-sized transparent CGImage, but that is 4·W·H bytes — consider a lazy/solid-clear ImageStore entry or bake-on-first-fill instead of materializing upfront).
designNotes.priorArt: Read first: EditorState.selection/setSelection + Marquee.swift (current rect model), CanvasView selectionBase/AntsLayer + MarqueeDrag, EdgeSnapping/EdgeMap (16.4/16.5), Fill.swift + fillLayer (16.11), rasterize(region:) (merge-down / ⌘C paths).

tasks.title: Core SelectionRegion: path model, rect/ellipse builders, booleans, bounds/contains (TDD) + CGPath-boolean spike
tasks.notes: SPIKE PASSED (2026-07-05): CGPath.union/subtracting/intersection all correct on macOS 26 — rects, ellipses, disjoint, holes, 20 chained ops; empty results come back isEmpty=true with null bbox. Built Sources/PhotonzCore/SelectionRegion.swift: init?(path) collapses no-area paths to nil, rect/ellipse builders, Mode{replace,add,subtract,intersect} + Mode(shift:option:) modifier mapping, combining(_:mode:), static combine(base?:with:mode:) (nil base: replace/add→shape, subtract/intersect→nil), bounds, contains (even-odd everywhere). @unchecked Sendable with comment (CGPath immutable copy at init; CGPath itself unmarked because CGMutablePath subclasses it). 17 tests in SelectionRegionTests.swift; 602 total green.

tasks.title: Marching-squares contour tracer: bitmap mask → CGPath (core, TDD)
tasks.notes: Sources/PhotonzCore/ContourTracer.swift: ContourTracer.path(fromMask:[Bool],width:,height:) -> CGPath?. Grid-edge tracing (not classic per-cell marching squares): each filled pixel emits directed clockwise edges on empty-facing sides, keyed (vertex*4+dir) — unique by construction; loops chained with right-turn-first at saddles so diagonal blobs stay separate contours; collinear runs merged (corners only). Pixel (x,y) covers unit square (x,y)-(x+1,y+1), top-left origin, even-odd like SelectionRegion. nil on empty/mis-sized mask. 11 tests (single px, full frame, two blobs, donut, ring+island=3 subpaths, diagonal, L-shape, SelectionRegion round-trip + boolean). 613 green.

tasks.title: Magic wand flood fill (render, TDD): composite sample + tolerance
tasks.notes: Sources/PhotonzRender/FloodFill.swift: FloodFill.mask(in: CGImage, from: CGPoint, tolerance:) -> Mask{[Bool],w,h}? + path(...) -> CGPath? convenience (mask → ContourTracer). Scanline fill, 4-connected; tolerance = Euclidean RGBA distance in 0–255 units vs the SEED pixel (PS semantics — no gradient creep; alpha included so transparent/opaque black differ). Decodes via CGContext RGBA8 top-left row order (same as EdgeMapAnalyzer). nil on out-of-bounds seed. 11 tests (boundaries, contiguity incl. diagonal no-leak, concave U, tolerance thresholds √(3·4²), seed-not-neighbor gradient, path round-trip). 624 green. Still TODO app-side: run off-main on wand click (composite can be 12MP).

tasks.title: Selection tools on canvas: rect/ellipse/wand + ⇧/⌥/⇧⌥ modifiers + edge snapping + ants (app)
tasks.notes: Tool gains rectSelect/ellipseSelect/wand + isRegionSelectionTool + preservesSelectionRegion (region survives switches within select family + fill; cleared for drawing/crop/text — tested). EditorState.selection is now SelectionRegion?; setSelection(region, captureLayers:) — arrow marquee still rubber-band-captures layers (true), region tools pass false. wandSelect(at:mode:) renders composite + FloodFill off-main (Task.detached, fresh DocumentRenderer), drops result if canvasSize changed; wandTolerance=32 (UI in 17.6). measureEdgeMap RENAMED snappingEdgeMap, gate widened to rectSelect/ellipseSelect. CanvasView: regionDrag state (mode latched at mousedown from ⇧/⌥), EdgeSnapping on anchor + dragged corner w/ spans + ⌘ bypass like measure, live ants = combine(base, shape, mode) as ONE path via doc→view affine (view is flipped; no y-inversion), Esc cancels drag; click w/ replace mode deselects, with modifier = no-op (PS). Arrow marquee commits SelectionRegion.rect. Rect consumers (promote/blur-behind/copy/crop-seed/layerIDs(fullyInside:)) use Geometry.pixelAligned(region.bounds) — path-clipped versions land in 17.5. Toolbar: rectangle.dashed / circle.dashed / wand.and.rays after Select; only wand has a key (W) — S/M taken; OPEN: letter keys for rect/ellipse select (ask user). 626 tests green.

tasks.title: Region-targeted ops: fill/erase/copy/promote on the region; ⌘N empty layer preserving selection
tasks.notes: KEY DESIGN: EditorState.selectionTargetsPixels distinguishes region-tool selections (pixel semantics) from arrow-marquee selections (layer semantics — rubber-band capture + batch ⌫ delete, the user's primary workflow, PRESERVED). RegionOps (render, 8 tests): filled/erased/extracted with even-odd path clip, top-left coords flipped once. bakeRegion maps doc→bitmap px via layer frame; refuses cropped/transformed layers (regionTargetID only offers bakeable image layers: hit → selected → locked Background intersecting region). Bucket with pixel region fills THE REGION (click outside = no-op, PS); ⌥⌫ fills region; ⌫ erases (locked Background → BG-color fill, PS delete-on-Background); ⌘C copies path-clipped composite (supersedes selected layer); ⌘J promotes path-clipped (transparent outside blob) and consumes selection like PS Layer-via-Copy. newEmptyLayer(): canvas-sized transparent bitmap (48MB@12MP — lazy variant deferred), added on top + selected, region preserved (flow: select → New Layer → bucket). Layer▸New Layer menu item, NO shortcut yet — ⌘N decision still open with user. 634 tests green; app smoke-launched clean. Interactive verify pending user.

tasks.title: Move region content (select tool) / outline (marquee tools) — PS Move-tool semantics
tasks.notes: USER QUESTION 2026-07-05 ('move the selection of content within the current layer — how does PS do it?'), answered with PS semantics and built: SELECT (V) drag starting inside a pixel region lifts the region's pixels off the bakeable target layer (regionTargetID) — hole behind is transparent, or BG color on the locked Background (PS Move-from-Background); content floats via the EXISTING DragPreview sprite machinery (EditorState.regionMove holds extracted+holed bitmaps; underlay = composite w/ temp holed ref, removed after render; canvas regionContentDrag drives previewedFrame from the CONTENT frame, not the layer frame; regionMoveHoldFrame = post-commit no-flash hold, cleared when dragPreview clears). ⌥-drag floats a COPY (no hole). Mouse-up bakes ONE undo step via RegionOps.stamped (new: source-over at top-left rect, TDD ×3) and the selection outline FOLLOWS the content (SelectionRegion.translated, core TDD ×2). Esc/zero-delta cancels — document untouched. MARQUEE tools: plain drag inside the region moves the PIXELS too (user 2026-07-05: 'makes no sense to move the selection box only by default' — deliberate PS deviation); ⌘-drag (or an unbakeable target) moves the OUTLINE only; ⇧/⌥ drags still combine. Deltas rounded to whole px. Wand keeps click-to-select (PS outline-drag deviation, noted). Follow-ups if user wants: arrow-key nudge of region content; move cursor over region. 639 tests green.

tasks.title: INTERJECTED (user 2026-07-06): in-app self-update — background check, menu-bar dot badge, one-click Update & Restart (no GitHub trip, no manual reinstall)
tasks.notes: USER: 'auto updating to reveal when a new version is available (glyph dot overlay in the status bar icon)' then 'I don't want to go to github to update, i just want it to update and restart' / 'I should never have to reinstall'. BUILT: (core, TDD ×9) CodesignInfo parse of codesign -dvv output (prefix-anchored so Authority lines can't spoof) + SelfUpdatePolicy verdict (bundle-id must match; download must have a real TeamIdentifier; when the RUNNING build has a team it must match — dev/adhoc builds pin nothing but still require a properly-signed download). (app) SelfUpdater: download versioned DMG (releases/download/vX.Y.Z/Photonz.dmg — stable per-version URL, no races with latest), hdiutil attach -nobrowse -readonly, verify codesign --verify --deep --strict + spctl --assess (notarization) + policy, ditto to staging, xattr -dr quarantine, detach, TRASH old bundle (recoverable; running process keeps its inode) + move staged into place; sideways-rename fallback when Trash fails. AppCoordinator: availableUpdate/updateStatus observable; startUpdateChecks() at launch +10s then every 6h (SKIPPED for dev builds — 0.0.0 would badge forever); installAvailableUpdate() → swap → pendingRelaunchBundlePath + NSApp.terminate; AppDelegate.applicationWillTerminate spawns 'sleep 0.5; open <bundle>' ONLY when the flag is set, and the flag is CLEARED on both quit-cancel paths (alert Cancel + review-not-resolved) so a later unrelated Quit can't fire a stale relaunch. UI: MenuBarIcon.image(updateAvailable:) hand-draws the dot into a template NSImage (SwiftUI overlays flatten unreliably in MenuBarExtra) with a punched gap; menu gains 'Update to vX.Y.Z & Restart' (label becomes the live phase while installing); Check for Updates… alert now offers Update & Restart (Download… fallback for dev builds). VERIFIED: real SelfUpdater run against a scratch dist copy restamped 0.3.0 → downloaded published v0.4.0, all checks passed, bundle became notarized 0.4.0 (spctl accepted, team VMGW2V57S7), old copy trashed; badge icon rendered to PNG (dot + gap reads clearly); 670 tests green. NOTE: users must install ONE more release manually — self-update only exists in builds that contain it.

tasks.title: INTERJECTED (user 2026-07-06): recording copy = Copy Video / Copy GIF that actually pastes (Teams); trim/crop honored by EVERY export/copy path
tasks.notes: USER: (1) copy button on a video should offer video vs GIF and pasting into Teams did nothing; (2) trim then export GIF still exported the full clip. REPRO'D (2): editor export is fine — the HISTORY OVERLAY export/copy knew nothing about editor-window edits (in-memory only). FIX: PhotonzCore VideoEdits{trim,crop} + VideoEditsSidecar (JSON '<basename>.photonzedits' next to the mp4; save(empty) deletes; 9 tests). VideoEditorState persists via debounced(300ms) persistEdits() on every trim/crop mutation, reloads sidecar in loadMetadata (trim comes back as LIVE handles), exportEdits = normalized cumulative edits. AppCoordinator.saveRecording(url:as:) now loads the sidecar (mp4-with-edits re-encodes via exportMP4); new copyRecording(entry/state, as:) — mp4 no-edits = direct file copy, else re-encode to temp (PhotonzClipboard dir, nice filename for paste) + completion TOAST. CaptureStore.trashSidecar also trashes .photonzedits. (1): ClipboardWriter.writeFile writes public.file-url + legacy NSFilenamesPboardType (what old Electron reads — matches Finder's flavor set exactly) + inline com.compuserve.gif for GIF copies; CaptureStore video copy + auto-copy-on-capture use it. UI: history overlay Copy on videos = menu{Copy Video, Copy GIF}; video editor gained the same copy menu next to Export. VERIFIED: harnesses compiled against the real classes — trimmed GIF 1.05s vs 7.45s source via the sidecar path; sidecar round-trip incl. reopen + clear-removes-file; pasteboard flavor dump matches Finder; real ⌘V into Chromium receives files:[...gif/mp4]. NOT verifiable locally: Teams itself (not installed) — if Teams still rejects the mp4 paste, Finder-copy→Teams would fail identically; Copy GIF is the fallback. 661 tests green.
tasks.assumption: Teams' paste handler accepts what Finder-copied files present; our flavor set now matches Finder's byte-for-byte in type coverage.

tasks.title: INTERJECTED (user 2026-07-06): first-run permissions walkthrough — welcome window explaining + guiding Screen Recording / Microphone / freeing ⌘⇧3-4-5 from macOS
tasks.notes: User: first capture failing on permissions is scary; walk them through up front, do what we can for them. FINDING: the app needs Screen Recording (required; grant only takes effect after relaunch) + Microphone (optional, narrated recordings) — NOT Accessibility (Carbon RegisterEventHotKey works without it). Third hurdle: macOS's own screenshot shortcuts swallow ⌘⇧3/4/5 (com.apple.symbolichotkeys IDs 28/30/184; missing entry = enabled). Built: PhotonzCore/SystemScreenshotShortcuts.swift (pure conflict detection, 8 tests) + Photonz/Welcome/{WelcomeController,WelcomeView}.swift — floating key panel at launch while welcome.setupCompleted defaults flag unset; 1s poll flips rows green live; mic granted fully in-app via AVCaptureDevice.requestAccess (guarded: falls back to Settings pane when no usage description, i.e. bare swift-build dev runs); Screen Recording button = CaptureCenter.requestScreenRecordingAccess (primes TCC + opens exact pane); grant-mid-session shows a Relaunch Photonz button (sh -c 'sleep 0.4; open <bundle>' then terminate). Completed = window closed WITH screen recording granted; otherwise re-presents next launch. Re-entry: menu 'Welcome & Permissions…' + history overlay hint now opens it (was a bare Settings link). Verified: 651 tests green; bundle launched with tccutil-reset ScreenCapture → window shows ungranted state; granted state screenshot-verified earlier. Pending user verify: live green flip on grant + relaunch flow.
